title: Pokkit
description: Colored completely white—hair, skin, and eyes— Pokkit was a charismatic bounty hunter who used to work for the guilds when she'd last ran into Jod Na Nawood by a different name. She had held a grudge ever since, though she had switched to working for a private client. When she ran into Jod on Lanupa, she turned him in to Captain Brutus for the bounty on his head.
